audience: busy adults near a Fjellbre branch who want a flexible membership

copy_lines.text: Bli med når det passer deg

hypothesis: a human hero clip plus AI cutdowns lifts memberships more than AI alone
insight: people join when a short clip shows the room is welcoming, not intimidating

maker_recommendation.rationale: a full human video needs 33 more memberships to pay off, about 22% of the goal, so pair a human hero clip with AI-made cutdowns

mandatories.text: Do not present an AI actor as a real member.
For EU reach, label realistic AI-made people under Article 50.

objective: fill Fjellbre's off-peak class slots across its branches
open_questions: is the value per membership of 700 kr steady across the branches?
proposition: a warm, real look at off-peak classes that earns 150 memberships
